script.title: THE STUCK SNACK MACHINE
script.scene_zh: 商場零食機 · 卡住退費
script.story_hook: My snack got stuck, and my card got charged.
script.intro_zh: 零食卡住了，卡片也扣了錢。
script.welcome_en: Hi friends, welcome back! Today a snack machine swallows some money.
script.welcome_zh: 哈囉，歡迎回來！今天一台零食機把錢吞了。
script.outro: That's today's story! Listen again, and repeat along.
script.outro_zh: 今天的故事就到這裡！再聽一遍，跟著唸一次。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each sentence together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一句一句一起跟讀。

script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🍬零食機英文｜說明卡住・申請退費・確認時間｜聽完就會用｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
錢莫名其妙扣了，零食卻卡在玻璃後面？
不會用英文申請退費，只能站在機台前發呆？

這一集帶大家走進商場走廊的自動零食機前，Levi 的餅乾卡住了，卡片也扣了錢。他從說明機器編號、交代扣款狀況，到填寫退款單、確認到帳時間，全程都是自然的美式口語。

你會聽到：
🍬 說明卡住與扣錢：例如「my snack got stuck」、「it took my money」。
🧾 申請退款與填單：例如「how long do refunds usually take」、「let me find the form」。
💳 確認時間與收尾：例如「a couple of days, maybe three at most」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下次零食卡在機器裡，換你自信開口，一句就講清楚！
script.title_quote: How long do refunds usually take

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, my snack got stuck behind the glass.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuːz miː maɪ snæk ɡɑt stʌk bɪˈhɪnd ðə ɡlæs/
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，我的零食卡在玻璃後面了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no, which machine was it, please?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ wɪtʃ məˈʃiːn wəz ɪt pliːz/
dialogue.zh: 噢不，請問是哪一台機器？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The one near the doors, number twelve.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wʌn nɪr ðə dɔːrz ˈnʌmbər twɛlv/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Well, that one jams when it gets cold.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ðæt wʌn dʒæmz wɛn ɪt ɡɛts koʊld/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，天氣一冷那台就常卡住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It took my money too. The screen shows zero.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt tʊk maɪ ˈmʌni tuː ðə skriːn ʃoʊz ˈzɪroʊ/
dialogue.zh: 它也扣了我的錢，螢幕顯示零。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I see. Did you keep the snack code, dear?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ siː dɪd ju kɪp ðə snæk koʊd dɪr/
dialogue.zh: 我知道了，親愛的，你有留零食的編號嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, B seven. I pressed it twice, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs bi ˈsɛvən aɪ prɛst ɪt twaɪs ˈɑnəstli/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm, that's strange. Which card did you use?
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌm ðæts streɪndʒ wɪtʃ kɑːrd dɪd ju juːz/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，那就怪了。你用什麼卡付的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A debit card. Could you check for me?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈdɛbɪt kɑːrd kʊd ju tʃɛk fɔːr miː/
dialogue.zh: 金融卡。可以幫我查一下嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, one second. Let me find the form.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr wʌn ˈsɛkənd lɛt mi faɪnd ðə fɔːrm/
dialogue.zh: 好的，稍等一下，我來找單子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will my card be fine? I only have this one.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl maɪ kɑːrd bi faɪn aɪ ˈoʊnli hæv ðɪs wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 我的卡沒問題吧？我只有這一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No worries, we fix these every week, really.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈwɜːriz wi fɪks ðiːz ˈɛvri wiːk ˈrɪli/
dialogue.zh: 別擔心，我們每週都在處理這種事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So I just fill this out and mail it?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ aɪ dʒʌst fɪl ðɪs aʊt ənd meɪl ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 所以我只要填這張，然後用郵寄？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No need, dear. I'll scan it right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ niːd dɪr aɪl skæn ɪt raɪt hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 不用，親愛的，我在這裡掃描就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great. How long do refunds usually take?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt haʊ lɔːŋ du ˈriːfʌndz ˈjuːʒuəli teɪk/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。退費通常要多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A couple of days, maybe three at most.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈkʌpəl əv deɪz ˈmeɪbi θriː ət moʊst/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks so much. Have a good shift!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime, son. Have a good day!
dialogue.zh: 不客氣，孩子，也祝你今天愉快！
